name: Blot
description: Blot the Ink Blob, also known as Blot, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on May 23, 2025. He is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Blot Jr.
abilities.description: This Toon places a decoy that attracts nearby Twisteds and has 1 Heart. This ability costs 10 Tapes and has a cooldown of 60 seconds. For each extra Blot on a team the cost of the decoy costs an additional 10 tapes.

name: Boxten
description: Boxten the Music Box, also known as Boxten, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on June 14, 2024. He is either available for free as your starter Toon, or, if  Poppy was chosen, is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Wind-Up
abilities.description: This Toon gains 6% more Extraction Speed for every alive Toon in the round. Maxes at 48%.

name: Brightney
description: Brightney the Lamp, also known as Brightney, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on June 14, 2024. She is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Night Light
abilities.description: This Toon can shine lights on Twisteds to make them visible during Blackouts for 8 seconds. Has a Cooldown of 45.

name: Brusha
description: Brusha the Paint Brush, also known as Brusha, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on August 8, 2025, alongside  Dyle. She is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Artistic Inspiration
abilities.description: Enter Painting Mode to inspire nearby Toons with a 50% Skill Check boost while they remain in your circle. This Toon moves 25% slower while in Painting Mode. Has a cooldown of 5.

name: Connie
description: Connie the Ghost, also known as Connie, Boolynski (real name) or Miss. Boolynski by  Rodger and the Halloween Toons, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on December 6th, 2024, alongside  Looey. She is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Haunting Escape
abilities.description: This Toon uses her ability to become invisible for 5 seconds. Twisteds will not be able to notice her during this time, unless she is up against a Lethal Twisted which will still see her. Has a cooldown of 50.

name: Cosmo
description: Cosmo the Pastry, also known as Cosmo, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on August 14th, 2024, alongside  Sprout,  Glisten, and  Finn. He is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Sharing is Caring
abilities.description: This Toon can give one of his own Hearts to heal a targeted Toon. Cannot be used when at 1 Heart. Has a Cooldown of 60.

name: Finn
description: Finn the Fish Bowl, also known as Finn, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on August 14th, 2024, alongside  Cosmo,  Glisten, and  Sprout. He is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Reel In
abilities.description: This Toon gains a 33% Movement Speed boost when any Machine is completed for 10 seconds.

name: Flutter
description: Flutter the Butterfly, also known as Flutter, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on July 12, 2024, alongside  Shelly,  Teagan, and  Tisha. She is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Floaty Dash
abilities.description: This Toon can dash forward, drastically increasing her Movement Speed for 0.75 seconds. Has a cooldown of 45 seconds.

name: Gigi
description: Gigi the Gachapon, also known as Gigi, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on September 28, 2024. She is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Surprise!
abilities.description: This Toon can grant herself a random item from any Tier (Dandy's Shop items included). Has a Cooldown of 80.

name: Glisten
description: Glisten the Mirror, also known as Glisten, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on August 14th, 2024, alongside  Sprout,  Cosmo, and  Finn. He is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Reflection
abilities.description: This Toon can travel through a mirror, instantly teleporting to a targeted Toon regardless of line of sight and can inflict Confused III on himself. Has a cooldown of 100.

name: Goob
description: Goob the Fluffy Craft, also known as Goob, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on June 14th, 2024. He is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Hug!
abilities.description: This Toon can pull other Toons towards his position. Needs direct line of sight. 30 second cooldown.

name: Looey
description: Looey the Balloon, also known as Looey, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on December 6, 2024, alongside  Connie. He is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Heart of Helium
abilities.description: For each missing heart this Toon has, they gain 20% more walk and run speed multiplier. At one heart, this Toon gains 40% more speed multiplier. His speed is reduced back when healed.

name: Poppy
description: Poppy the Bubble, also known as Poppy, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on June 14, 2024. She is either available as your starter Toon or, if  Boxten was chosen instead, is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Panic Pop
abilities.description: This Toon receives a 50% Speed boost for 3 seconds when attacked.

name: Rodger
description: Rodger the Magnifying Glass, also known as Rodger, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on June 14, 2024. He is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Detective
abilities.description: This Toon gains twice the amount of Research from Capsules and encountering Twisteds.

name: Scraps
description: Scraps the Paper Craft, also known as Scraps, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on June 14th, 2024. She is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Crafty Grapple
abilities.description: This Toon can pull herself towards another Toon or Machine's targeted position. Needs direct line of sight. 25 second cooldown.

name: Shrimpo
description: Shrimpo the Shrimp, also known as Shrimpo, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on June 14, 2024. He is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Bully
abilities.description: Stealth is drastically lower than any other Toon. Only play this Toon if you are looking for a challenge.

name: Teagan
description: Teagan the Teacup, also known as Teagan, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on July 12, 2024, alongside  Flutter,  Shelly, and  Tisha. She is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Tea Time
abilities.description: This Toon can spend 75 Tapes to heal themselves by 1 Heart. Has a Cooldown of 100.

name: Tisha
description: Tisha the Tissue Box, also known as Tisha, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on July 12, 2024, alongside  Flutter,  Shelly, and  Teagan. She is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Tidy Up!
abilities.description: This Toon can create a pulse that increases the Movement Speed of Toons around her by 25% for 5 seconds. Has a Cooldown of 50.

name: Toodles
description: Toodles the Eight Ball, also known as Toodles, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on June 14, 2024. She is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Beginner's Luck
abilities.description: This Toon can roll for a 15% boost to a random Stat that lasts for 10 seconds. Has a cooldown of 25.

name: Yatta
description: Yatta the Piñata, also known as Yatta, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on March 14, 2025. She is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Piñata Party
abilities.description: This Toon drops 2 random candy items after completing a machine, and 4 random candy items when injured.

name: Bassie
description: Bassie, full name Bassie Bloomington, is one of the 12 playable Holiday Toons and one of the 8 playable Main Characters in Dandy's World. She was introduced on April 18, alongside  Cocoa,  Eggson, and  Flyte. She is only available during the Easter Event in Bassie's Store.

abilities.name: Springful Sharing
abilities.description: This Toon can drop items from her inventory, sharing them with other Toons.

abilities.name: Easter Basket
abilities.description: This Toon's basket provides her with an extra inventory slot for carrying 1 extra item.

name: Gourdy
description: Gourdy, full name Gourdy Holloway, is one of the 12 playable Holiday Toons and one of the 8 playable Main Characters in Dandy's World. He was introduced on October 10, 2025, alongside  Eclipse,  Ribecca, and  Soulvester. He is only available during the Halloween Event in Gourdy's Store.

abilities.name: Trick or Treat
abilities.description: This Toon applies a random 20% boost for 15 seconds to all Toons within range. Has a cooldown of 35.

abilities.name: Sugar Rush
abilities.description: Provides a 20% speed boost to all Players for 5 seconds when the Elevator opens and when Panic Mode begins.

name: Pebble
description: Pebble, full name Pebble Dancifer Jr., is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on June 14, 2024. He is one of the 8 playable Main Characters and can be purchased in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Speak!
abilities.description: This Toon can bark loudly, drastically decreasing Stealth to a value of -40 and alerting any Twisteds nearby to his location. Has a cooldown of 60.

abilities.name: Fetch!
abilities.description: This Toon can sniff out items, causing them to be highlighted when in the Toon's vicinity.

name: Shelly
description: Shelly, full name Shelly Fossilian, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on July 12, 2024, alongside  Flutter,  Teagan, and  Tisha. She is one of the 8 playable Main Characters and can be purchased in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Inspiration
abilities.description: This Toon can boost the Extraction Speed of a selected Toon by 75% for 15 seconds. Has a cooldown of 60.

abilities.name: Problem Solver
abilities.description: This Toon gains a 25% Movement Speed boost when any Machine is completed for 10 seconds.

name: Sprout
description: Sprout, full name Sprout Seedly, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on August 14, 2024, alongside  Cosmo,  Finn, and  Glisten. He is one of the 8 playable Main Characters and can be purchased in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Baked Sweets
abilities.description: This Toon can heal a targeted Toon by 1 Heart at the cost of 100 Tapes. For each extra Sprout, the cost increases by 50 Tapes and the Cooldown increases by 30. Has a cooldown of 100.

abilities.name: Overprotective
abilities.description: This Toon can see where all the other alive Toons are, along with their current Health status.

name: Vee
description: Vee, full name Vee Version 1, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on June 14, 2024. She is one of the 8 playable Main Characters and can be purchased in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Mic Check
abilities.description: This Toon can highlight all Twisteds and Machines on the Floor for 5 seconds. Has a Cooldown of 50.

abilities.name: Camera Hijack
abilities.description: This Toon will have the 2 nearest uncompleted Machines highlighted for them.

name: Cocoa
description: Cocoa the Chocolate Bunny, also known as Cocoa, is one of the 12 Holiday Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on April 18, 2025, alongside  Bassie,  Eggson, and  Flyte. She is only available during the Easter Event in Bassie's Store.

abilities.name: Bonbon
abilities.description: This Toon places a Bonbon candy item that can be picked up and used by anyone. When used, the Bonbon boosts extraction speed (+50%) and movement speed (+25%) for 5 seconds. Has a cooldown of 40.

name: Eggson
description: Eggson the Egg, also known as Eggson, is one of the 12 Holiday Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on April 18, 2025, alongside  Bassie,  Cocoa, and  Flyte. He is only available during the Easter Event in Bassie's Store.

abilities.name: Fixer Upper
abilities.description: This Toon hits a machine with his cane when he first extracts from it, granting 10% completion. This can only be used once per machine.

name: Flyte
description: Flyte the Butterfly, also known as Flyte, is one of the 12 Holiday Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on April 18, 2025, alongside  Bassie,  Cocoa, and  Eggson. He is only available during the Easter Event in Bassie's Store.

abilities.name: Gust
abilities.description: This Toon places a "Gust" at his location for 10 seconds. Any Toon that walks into the Gust recieves a +15% Movement Speed boost for 5 seconds. Has a cooldown of 50.

name: Eclipse
description: Eclipse the Werewolf, also known as Eclipse, is one of the 12 Holiday Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on October 10, 2025, alongside  Gourdy,  Ribecca, and  Soulvester. She is only available during the Halloween Event in Gourdy's Store.

abilities.name: Total Eclipse
abilities.description: This Toon transforms into a werewolf in blackouts, giving off a glow, gaining 2 Stamina Stars, and a 20% Movement Speed boost.

name: Ribecca
description: Ribecca the Skeleton, also known as Ribecca, is one of the 12 Holiday Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on October 10, 2025, alongside  Eclipse,  Gourdy, and  Soulvester. She is only available during the Halloween Event in Gourdy's Store.

abilities.name: The Undead
abilities.description: Ribecca is immune to all applied debuffs (does not include trinkets)

name: Soulvester
description: Soulvester the Ghostly Knight, also known as Soulvester, is one of the 12 Holiday Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on October 10, 2025, alongside  Eclipse,  Gourdy, and  Ribecca. He is only available during the Halloween Event in Gourdy's Store.

abilities.name: Knightly Armor
abilities.description: This Toon has an extra heart and is immune to damage from ranged attacks.

name: Razzle & Dazzle
description: Razzle & Dazzle the Twin Masks, also known as Razzle & Dazzle, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on June 14, 2024. He is available to be bought in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Comedy/Tragedy
abilities.description: This Toon swaps between Movement Speed on odd numbered Floors, and Extraction Speed on even numbered Floors.

name: Astro
description: Astro, full name Astro Novalite, is one of the 38 playable Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on June 14, 2024. He is one of the 8 playable Main Characters and can be purchased in Dandy's Store.

abilities.name: Nap Time
abilities.description: This Toon can create a pulse that fully restores the Stamina of the Toons around him. Has a cooldown of 60.

abilities.name: Well Rested
abilities.description: This Toon regenerates Stamina 50% faster, and can see Toons below 50% Stamina around the map. And can see the exact amount below 50%.

name: Bobette
description: Bobette, full name Bobette Carolynne, is one of the 12 playable Holiday Toons and one of the 8 playable Main Characters in Dandy's World. She was introduced on January 10, 2025, alongside  Coal,  Ginger, and  Rudie. She is only available during the Christmas Event in Bobette's Store.

abilities.name: Precious Packaging
abilities.description: This Toon can duck and cover herself into a gift box for 8 seconds, in which she is invincible yet unable to move. Has a cooldown of 90.

abilities.name: Festive Aura
abilities.description: The festive aura of this Toon passively gives those around her 50% faster stamina regeneration and a 25% speed boost that lasts for 5 seconds.

name: Coal
description: Coal the Pet Rock, also known as Coal, is one of the 12 Holiday Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on January 10, 2025, alongside Bobette Render Bobette, Ginger Render Ginger, and Rudie Render Rudie. She is only available during the Christmas Event in Bobette's Store.

abilities.name: Scout
abilities.description: This Toon can sniff out items across the map, causing items to be highlighted for all Toons for 10 seconds. Has a cooldown of 30.

name: Ginger
description: Ginger the Cookie, also known as Ginger, is one of the 12 Holiday Toons in Dandy's World. She was introduced on January 10, 2025, alongside  Bobette,  Coal, and  Rudie. She is only available during the Christmas Event in Bobette's Store.

abilities.name: Baked with Care!
abilities.description: This toon can heal a nearby targeted Toon to full Hearts for 100 tapes with a cooldown of 100. For every extra Ginger, the cost increases by 50 Tapes and the Cooldown increases by 30.

name: Rudie
description: Rudie the Reindeer, also known as Rudie, is one of the 12 Holiday Toons in Dandy's World. He was introduced on January 10, 2025, alongside  Bobette,  Coal, and  Ginger. He is only available during the Christmas Event in Bobette's Store.

abilities.name: Antler Charge
abilities.description: This Toon uses his antlers to quickly charge forward in a short burst, increasing his movement speed for 0.4 seconds. Has a Cooldown of 23.

name: Dandy
description: Dandy, full name Dandicus Dancifer, is the titular Toon and mascot of Dandy's World. He acts as a shopkeeper for Items purchasable in-between rounds, Toons, Gamepasses, and is a developer-exclusive playable character, though is also playable in Roleplay Mode as both a Toon, and a Twisted.

abilities.name: Dandy's World
abilities.description: The star of the show.

name: Dyle
description: Dyle, full name Dyle Timesly, is one of the two Lethal Toons in Dandy's World, added on August 8, 2025, alongside  Brusha. He acts as a shopkeeper, selling cosmetics like UGC Items, Gamepasses, Stickers, and Toon Skins.

abilities.name: Dyle's World
abilities.description: The star of the show.
